jobs_results.title: Programador/a Fullstack
jobs_results.description:
Krell-consulting busca un Programador FULLSTACK con al menos 3 años de experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo. Buscamos a alguien con habilidades tanto en el desarrollo de Backend como en el Frontend capaz de trabajar en un entorno dinámico y colaborativo.

Responsabilidades

Desarrollar aplicaciones web y móviles utilizando tecnologías como Java Springboot APIs Apigee MongoDb Kafka y AWS.

Diseñar y desarrollar experiencias de usuario atractivas en el Frontend utilizando Angular JavaScript TypeScript y Web Components.

Implementar servicios en la nube y gestionarlos en entornos como Kubernetes.

Colaborar en la implementación de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando herramientas como Jenkins.

Monitorear y optimizar el rendimiento de las aplicaciones utilizando herramientas como Dynatrace.

Colaborar en la gestión de código utilizando Git.

Requisitos

Licenciatura en Informática Ingeniería de Sistemas o Ciclo Formativo de Grado Superior.

Mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo... FULLSTACK.

Experiencia trabajando con tecnologías Backend como Java Springboot APIs Apigee MongoDb Kafka y AWS.

Experiencia trabajando con tecnologías Frontend como Angular JavaScript TypeScript y Web Components.

Conocimientos de implementación en entornos de contenedores como Kubernetes.

Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando herramientas como Jenkins.

Familiaridad con herramientas de monitoreo de rendimiento como Dynatrace.

Experiencia en la gestión de código utilizando Git.

Beneficios

Salario competitivo en base a la experiencia aportada

Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional.

Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo.

Proyectos interesantes y desafiantes en entorno internacional

Teletrabajo (de 3 a 4 días por semana)

Java, Springboot, APIs, Apigee, MongoDb, Kafka, AWS, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a  Backend de Java, Python, AWS
jobs_results.description:
En Getronics queremos ampliar nuestro equipo incorporando a un/a Backed Developer para nuestro cliente, líder mundial en gestión de infraestructuras de transporte y servicios de movilidad, en modalidad remota o híbrida (80% en remoto) en Madrid con horario de entrada flexible y los viernes y los meses de julio y agosto jornada intensiva.

La persona que se incorpore nos ayudará con la creación de programas y sistemas pruebas y códigos eficientes que cumplan con las necesidades de esta gran grupo.

REQUISITOS
• Experiencia mínima en de 4 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software con tecnologías Java y Python con al menos, 2 de ellos experiencia en desarrollos en la nube, preferentemente AWS.
• Experiencia haciendo containers para Docker.
• Conocimientos de arquitectura y patrones de diseño.
• Soltura en BBDD Postgres (valorable Opensearch).
• Experiencia con protocolos de red y metodologías ágiles.

Se valorará positivamente tener experiencia o conocimientos del:
• Campo de... logística/aeroespacial.

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?
• Podrás crearte tu propio plan de formación, seleccionando tus propios contenidos entre una plataforma propia con más de 15.000 opciones a tu alcance, entre las que encontrarás contenidos acerca de las últimas tecnologías, metodologías ágiles, finanzas personales o salud mental, entre muchas otras opciones.
• Estabilidad, ya que formarás parte de una empresa con 130 años de historia y 4.000 empleados en 23 países, de los cuales, 1.800 están en España.
• Crecimiento profesional. Tendrás acceso a todas las vacantes de Getronics por si quieres dar un salto en tu carrera. Además, ponemos a tu disposición GetLead, un programa destinado a acompañar en el camino a nuestros futuros líderes.
• Formarás parte de un gran equipo con el que crecer día a día.
• Podrás acogerte a retribución flexible para que puedas beneficiarte de aquello que más se ajuste a tus necesidades: ticket restaurante, guardería, transporte, seguro privado…

Si consideras que la posición encaja con tu perfil y cumples con los requisitos indicados, ¡INSCRÍBETE AHORA! Estamos deseando conocerte

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer - Kraken Technologies
jobs_results.description:
Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.p.

More recently, we have acquired the green energy start up Umeme in order to bring the green energy revolution to the Spanish market. Read more HERE.

It's in making this vision a reality that we are looking for you to help us achieve this.

Our team

All technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 500 people globally. This includes server-side, client-side and mobile engineers working closely with UX experts, copywriters and... designers.

We follow a Kanban-like approach, using Google docs and Asana to specify and manage work; Github, CircleCI and Terraform Enterprise as part of an immutable-infrastructure, continuous delivery pipeline; and Loggly, Sentry and Cloudwatch to measure performance and monitor production.

Some of our coding conventions are open-source .

Octopus is a great place to learn, work with some talented engineers and level-up your skills.

Our technology

On the server-side, we mainly use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django, Django-REST-framework and GraphQL (Graphene).

We use AWS heavily, employing most of the "Hashistack" (eg Packer, Consul, Terraform) as part of a continuous deployment pipeline. See, for example, Django, ELB health checks and continuous delivery.

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.

What You'll Do
• We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The Spanish energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.
• We have difficult technical problems to solve. With the advent of smart meters, we'll soon be processing millions of meter readings a day. We need the right technology in place to handle this smoothly as well as feeding data into a machine learning pipeline that models and predicts consumption.
• There's a great opportunity for disruption in the Spanish energy market. The big suppliers still dominate, but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology. Octopus Energy were the first UK supplier to introduce a "tracker" tariff whose prices track the daily wholesale prices: http://www.cleanenergynews.co.uk/news/efficiency/octopus-offers-transparency-with-wholesale-price-tariff
• You'll be working for a company that’s fighting climate change. Our parent company is the largest investor in solar generation in the UK, and are funding wind and anaerobic digestion. As a supplier, we're helping people to use greener technology and renewable energy, all helping move the UK towards a lower carbon future.

What You'll Have
• We're looking for someone with a general interest in technology and problem-solving; someone diligent and thoughtful. It would be helpful to have experience/expertise in the following (in rough priority order):
• Python
• Django (or equiv. web framework)
• Domain modelling
• HTTP and REST APIs
• Writing robust and fault-tolerant software
• Celery and async processing
• Postgres
• English & Spanish

Plus experience in the following would be a bonus:
• AWS
• Terraform, Packer, Consul
• React and Redux

You do need to be able to work in Spain/EU without a VISA though.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who thrives on providing alternative opinions, challenging those around them and being challenged

jobs_results.title: Frontend Lead Developer
jobs_results.description:
¡Únete a nuestro equipo como Frontend Lead Developer

Somos una empresa innovadora y buscamos un desarrollador frontend talentoso y motivado con al menos 3 años de experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo de profesionales apasionados por el desarrollo de software.

Responsabilidades
• Desarrollar interfaces de usuario atractivas y eficientes basadas en especificaciones de diseño.
• Colaborar estrechamente con diseñadores, desarrolladores backend y otros miembros del equipo para implementar nuevas características y mejorar las existentes.
• Optimizar aplicaciones web para mejorar la velocidad y la escalabilidad.
• Mantenerse actualizado con las últimas tendencias y tecnologías en desarrollo frontend.

¿Qué necesitas?
• Experiencia sólida en JavaScript/TypeScript y SCSS/CSS.
• Familiaridad con frameworks modernos de frontend (por ejemplo, React, Svelte, Vue.js).
• Diploma universitario en Informática, Ingeniería de Software o campo relacionado.
• Capacidad de gestión y liderazgo.
•... Excelente comunicación escrita en español e inglés.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Trabajo 100% remoto con flexibilidad horaria
• Rango salarial competitivo, acorde a la experiencia del candidato.
• Vacaciones pagadas.
• Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo de carrera en un ambiente dinámico y colaborativo.

Soft Skills
• Autodidacta: Capacidad demostrada para aprender de forma autónoma y adaptarse a nuevas tecnologías.
• Iniciativa y Proactividad: Perfil que demuestre iniciativa en la identificación de oportunidades y la toma de acciones para alcanzar los objetivos establecidos.
• Resolución de Problemas: Habilidad para analizar situaciones complejas, identificar problemas y encontrar soluciones efectivas de manera creativa y eficiente.

Si cumples con estos requisitos y estás listo para un nuevo desafío emocionante, ¡esperamos recibir tu solicitud

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Senior BackEnd Developer

An enterprise software company is seeking an experienced Backend developer to work on advanced AI resource planning, optimization and information retrieval system, whose key aspects include a multi-agent system, multiple constraints (resources, time) and priorities (projects) to assign optimally the resources to the projects. The successful candidate will join atechnically leading-edge AI deployment for an enterprise application dedicated to complex workplace planning, control and monitoring. It consists on a 100% remote position.

Job Description

- Develop fast, scalable and highly available web applications.

- Dedicated to delivering tested and optimized high-performance, high-quality code.

- Work in an agile environment.

- Participate in resolution of production issues and lead efforts toward solutions.

- Drive new features from inception to production, working across the company with product

managers, UI designers and other stakeholders.

- Lead in... the BackEnd technologies and architecture decision-making.

Requirements

- BS or MS in computer science.

- More than 3 years of experience as BackEnd developer for enterprise web applications.

- Excellent with the following BackEnd technologies: PHP, microservices, Node, Python,

- Experience with SQL: PostgreSQL and MySql as well as ORM models.

- Strongly valuable experience with linux systems and scripting (bash).

- Strongly valuable knowledge of Angular 6, React Native, Vue.js and other state-of-the-

art FrontEnd technologies.

- Living within the EU.

What we offer

• Multidisciplinary and multicultural working environment

• Flexi-time working hours

• Fridays afternoon off

• A productive work environment

• Ticket Restaurant, Ticket Transport, Ticket Kindergarten (Optional)

• Grant up to 50% of the annual cost of your sport centre

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java)
jobs_results.description:
About Caravelo

Caravelo partners with airlines globally to increase productivity, revenue, and customer experience.

Founded in 2010, our mission is to modernize the industry's complex legacy systems. Through our SaaS platform, airlines can boost customer loyalty and unlock hidden revenue. Highly tailored to the market, region and customer-base, our key products include chatbots, subscriptions and upgrades.

With 49 team members and over $3M in funding so far, we are growing at a fast rate. In the past decade of uniting passengers and airlines, we are recognised as the go-to provider for true innovation.

Are you looking for your next job at a successful enterprise SaaS scaleup, being part of an international and bright team? We are looking for our next Backend Developer to join our DEV team!

The mission

You will build great quality software that contributes to the continuous improvement and evolution of Caravelo SaaS products, by analyzing business requirements, designing... technical implementations, coding elegant, solid and extendable solutions, improving software performance and error handling, cooperating with other developers and product specialists, and delivering on time by coordinating with tech leads.

Duties and responsibilities

Reporting To The CTO, You Will
• Implement existing product lines and help us develop new ones!
• Integrate our product lines with Airlines' reservation and payment systems (Sabre, Amadeus, Navitaire)
• Develop REST APIs
• Support new business domains and use cases
• Personalize our existing product lines to adapt to our partners' needs

Required Skills And Experience
• You are proficient in object-oriented analysis and design.
• You have solid Java/JVM or equivalent programming skills.
• You have at least 2+ years of experience as a backend developer.
• If you have any knowledge of Airline IT (i.e. Amadeus, Navitaire, Sabre, SITA) will be highly valued.
• It'd be great (but not mandatory) if you have any front-end knowledge or experience.
• You can communicate fluently in English (it's our company language!). Any Spanish knowledge is more than welcome!

Besides tech skills, we really value in a candidate:
• Passion: you are happy to work independently in a group and you enjoy sharing your expertise with junior team members and have a good sense of humour.
• Curiosity: develop new product lines is intriguing to you because you are full of ideas.
• You are autonomous and proactive.
• You’re versatile and enjoy learning new technologies and languages
• You are action-orientated and with enthusiasm

What we offer
• Possibility to work Full-Remote and with flexible working hours
• We offer you a competitive salary according to your experience.
• If you live in Spain, you will access to benefits paid from your gross salary (Health insurance, Transport/Restaurant/Kindergarten check) and discounted gym membership.
• You will be joining a fast-moving and progressive company that prides itself on being at the forefront of software development within the airline industry.
• A real chance to grow: there's plenty of room for personal development.
• The possibility to really see an impact and to see how your work affects the end result.

At Caravelo we are always looking for people with the right mix of passion, authenticity, and attitude to join our team. We are also proud to be an inclusive, equal opportunity employer

jobs_results.title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER BACK-END FIRST
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos a un profesional con pasión por la tecnología y un enfoque práctico en el desarrollo de backend.

Deberás tener:
• Experiencia avanzada en desarrollo backend: Profundo conocimiento en Python, FastAPI, y Express, con al menos 2-3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend, incluyendo la implementación de aplicaciones en entornos de producción.
• Creación y consumo de API Rest: Experiencia en el desarrollo y uso de API REST y adopción del enfoque “API First”.
• Arquitectura y diseño de software: Conocimientos en arquitectura hexagonal/limpia y Diseño Dirigido por el Dominio (DDD).
• Gestión de bases de datos complejas: Experiencia en la gestión y optimización de bases de datos relacionales (MySQL, PostgreSQL) y NoSQL (MongoDB), incluyendo bases de datos geolocalizadas y de series temporales.
• Prácticas avanzadas de desarrollo y testing: Experiencia en implementar prácticas de desarrollo de código limpio, SOLID, TDD, y CI/CD utilizando herramientas como Docker y Kubernetes.
•... Integración de tecnologías emergentes: Experiencia en la integración de tecnologías emergentes como GIS, IIoT, IoT, y ML/DL para fortalecer el producto…

Formación académica:

Grado superior en Ingeniería Informática o titulación similar.

Idiomas:

Nivel alto de inglés.

Experiencia:

M  nimo 2-3 años de experiencia como desarrollador back-end.

¡Si buscas un desafío apasionante en el mundo IT, envíanos tu currículum ahora y únete a nuestro equipo de profesionales líderes en el sector

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java) - 23421
jobs_results.description:
Description

Why YOU want this position

Enverus has expanded its solutions in Power & Renewables with the addition of RatedPower. A high growth start-up, RatedPower’s technology expands our portfolio of solutions in solar with its cloud-based software that automates and optimizes the feasibility study, analysis, design and engineering of solar power plants, and our geographical coverage internationally.

Enverus is the leading energy SaaS company delivering highly technical insights and predictive/prescriptive analytics that empower customers to make decisions that increase profit. Enverus’ innovative technologies drive production and investment strategies, enable best practices for energy and commodity trading and risk management, and reduce costs through automated processes across critical business functions. Enverus is a strategic partner to more than 6,000 customers in 50 countries.

We are currently seeking a Backend Developer to join our RatedPower team working in Madrid or... remote. This role offers the opportunity to join a rapidly growing company delivering industry-leading solutions. Be a part of the energy transition and join our growing team, creating intelligent connections across the energy value chain with a strategic focus on growing our offerings in Power & Renewables.

What You’ll Do
• Improve pvDesign by developing new or improving functionalities, with efficient, reusable, and easy to maintain code.
• Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, Frontend teams, to frame and tackle the challenges, both from a technical and business context.
• Manage and improve CI procedures.
• Administrate and maintain cloud infrastructure with guidance from our devSecOps engineers.
• Identify and implement improvements that reduce technical debt and enable the team to iterate faster.

What You Should Have
• Experience working with Java, SpringBoot, and object-oriented programming
• Experience working with relational databases like MySQL and non-relational like mongoDB
• Strong motivation to drive impact by making product or infrastructure improvements
• Previous experience writing unitary tests
• Deep understanding of architectural principles and design patterns
• Proactiveness, team player and willingness to teach & learn from peer
• Continuous integration and issue tracking tools such JIRA

What We Offer
• Face new and amazing challenges leveraging the newest technologies: we work with SpringBoot, GraphQL, Java 17, MySQL 8.0, AWS, automated testing, etc.
• You choose: position fully remote (based in Spain) or hybrid working model (able to combine working from home and from our office in Madrid city center).
• Career development according to your aspirations and interests.
• Opportunity to develop yourself and to be part of a fast-growing startup. You'll have a direct impact on our way of working and decisions made in the business
